facts.status_note: The lookout is gone. Sources describe only an old lookout site on the trail, not what remains.

access.note: A popular trail in the Table Rock Wilderness leads to the old lookout site. The lookout itself is gone.

notes_for_editor: This is the Clackamas County Table Rock (brief id us-or-table-rock, 44.97015, -122.31006). It is not the Baker County Table Rock, which is standing and has its own record (us-or-table-rock-2). Several page reads went to the Baker County pages while identifying the right site. The firelookout.com page (tablerock35) does not show its county in the cached text; the attribution rests on the firelookout.org index entry and the Clackamas-Marion text on the Oregon Forest Lookouts page. Sources disagree on the end date: firelookout.com says abandoned in the 1940s, and a 1946 map still lists it as a state lookout. The structure's construction date and type are unknown in every source. No corrections are proposed. Nothing in the sources describes the site's present condition beyond the 'old lookout site' line from a regional guide, which is undated in our cache, so a visitor should be told only that the lookout is gone. No photos were found.
